Iran accuses Washington of ceasefire violation while US forces remain deployed. Probability 93%. Rising/imminent.

The Lebanon front remains dangerous but below the Gulf flashpoint. Probability 56%. Falling/imminent.

india.name: India Pakistan
india.notes: May 10 midday scan: AP/BBC/Al Jazeera/Fox results report India missile strikes into Pakistani-controlled territory, Pakistani characterization as an act of war, explosions in Kashmir, and outside calls to de-escalate. china.name: China Taiwan
china.notes: May 10 midday scan: Taiwan is launching civil-military drills to secure energy routes amid blockade concern, while ISW/AEI report PLA Navy major deployments in the South China Sea and West Pacific. No invasion trigger, but blockade rehearsal risk is up. Probability 28%. Rising/critical.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: May 10 midday scan: CNA reports Kim ordered more missile production and oversaw a new-type high-altitude long-range anti-air missile test launch. No atomic-device event is indicated. Probability 19%. Rising/elevated.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia Ukraine
